locations.note: B.J. carries a portable nuclear warhead to Roswell, plants it in the reactor of the Oberkommando and detonates it after escaping.
B.J. detours to his hometown to recover an heirloom ring, kills his father Rip and is captured by Engel.
B.J. breaks into a Nazi bunker under New York to steal a file on New Orleans, after the resistance has hidden in the ruins of Manhattan.
New Orleans has been walled off as a ghetto; B.J. breaks in to recruit Horton Boone.
The resistance assaults a studio complex where Engel is on national television, and B.J. kills her.
A resistance cell hides in the Empire State Building amid the atomic ruins of Manhattan.
Sentenced in a kangaroo court, B.J. is beheaded on international television at the Lincoln Memorial.

routes.name: B.J.'s liberation tour
routes.note: B.J. goes from Roswell to his family farm in Mesquite, the ruins of Manhattan and walled-off New Orleans, is put on trial in Washington and fights the last battle in Hollywood.
